findings.title: Undocumented frozen-box clamping flattens post-head samples onto the display box -- visibly distorts the project's own iris tutorial example (100/150 points clamped)
findings.repro:
env MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python -c "
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
import hypertools as hyp
from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset('scikit-learn/iris', split='train', streaming=True)
ds = ds.select_columns(['SepalLengthCm', 'SepalWidthCm', 'PetalLengthCm', 'PetalWidthCm'])
fig = hyp.plot(ds, '.', markersize=6, stream_init=50, stream_chunk=25, show=False)
fig.savefig('/tmp/iris_streamed.png')
"  # top-edge band = 100 clamped samples
findings.expected: Either the post-head samples remain faithfully placed (e.g. axes rescale or clamping is clearly disclosed in hyp.plot docs + tutorials), or at least a runtime warning when a large fraction of streamed samples is being clamped.
findings.actual: Streamed iris: dense straight band of points pinned along the top box edge (see x5 side-by-side); measured 'samples landing outside frozen box (clamped): 100 of 150'. Static plot of the identical 150 rows shows two separated clusters mid-box.

findings.title: Any mid-stream error (LSL source death, NaN sample, source exception) loses the figure, ALL consumed data, and the entire animation file
findings.expected: On a source error: finalize the animation, attach stream_info (with the consumed data) to the figure, and either return the figure with a warning or re-raise an exception that still references the partial results -- matching the documented "finalized whenever streaming stops" contract.
findings.actual: REAL LSL run (L10): 'HypertoolsIOError propagated: "LSL stream (name='AuditDies-82230') stopped delivering samples: nothing received for ~2.0s. The source may have disconnected." | figure+300 consumed samples LOST, gif exists=False'. Generator run (E18): RuntimeError propagated; gif size=-1 (never created); figure/stream_info LOST. NaN run (E12): ValueError: Input X contains NaN. IncrementalPCA does not accept missing values...

findings.title: Most hyp.plot kwargs are silently dropped for streaming inputs (hue, legend, animate, ...) while align/cluster raise
findings.repro:
env MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python -c "
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
import warnings, hypertools as hyp
def g():
    for i in range(150):
        yield [float(i), i*0.5, i*0.1]
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
    warnings.simplefilter('always')
    fig = hyp.plot(g(), stream_init=50, stream_chunk=50, hue=list(range(150)), legend=['s'], show=False)
print('warnings:', [str(x.message) for x in w], 'legend:', fig.axes[0].get_legend())
"
findings.expected: Unsupported-for-streams kwargs either warn or raise (like align/cluster do), or the docstring states which parameters apply to streaming inputs.
findings.actual: warnings: []  legend: None  (hue/legend/animate all silently ignored)

findings.title: lsl_stream docstring omits the mid-stream silence abort: timeout is documented only as resolve wait, but iteration also raises HypertoolsIOError after ~timeout seconds without samples
findings.expected: timeout/Raises docs also state: the generator raises HypertoolsIOError if no sample arrives for ~timeout seconds mid-stream.
